# #18771 two-level brace-elision KNOWN-DIVERGENT INVENTORY (equals-gate)
#
# Each line: <site> TAB <strict drop shape>. A site is the census leaf whose
# `outer inner leaf value;` spelling (two container levels packed onto one
# line) compiles differently from its fully braced twin on the tolerant path.
#
#   REFUSED            strict commit rejects the two-level spelling and accepts
#                      the braced twin: loud, the safe kind
#   COMMITS-DIFFERENT  strict commit accepts both and they compile differently:
#                      the silent shape that hid strict-syn-check (#18762)
#   UNCLASSIFIED       the census's synthesized braced twin is itself refused
#                      strictly, so this fixture cannot tell (needs a hand fixture)
#
# TestCompactBlockEquivalenceInventory2419 fails on a NEW divergent site, on a
# listed site that now compiles equivalently (remove the line: the list only
# shrinks), and on any shape change. Sites under `security flow` are not
# allowed here at all (asserted divergence-free). Seeded 2026-11-01 from
# origin/master d199fe64b6 + #18763; triage in #18771.
